ad_slots.ad_headline: The #1 Roth Conversion Mistake That Costs Retirees

notes: AD CAPACITY LESSON (2026-08-20): The beehiiv ad network only allocated ONE ad opportunity slot for this post today, even though list_ad_offers returned 4 available offers (Q3 Advisors 225c, Mindstream 168c, Morning Brew 150c, 1440 Media 150c, all send_by 2026-08-25). Placing a second ad block (primary OR secondary) was rejected: first with 'No primary ad slot is available in this post' (2+ primaries), then 'can not accept any more opportunities' (1 primary + 1 secondary, and again 1 primary + 1 secondary). Only the single highest-payout offer (Q3 Advisors, primary) could be placed; slots 2 and 3 fell back to labeled placeholders. The per-post opportunity count is set by real-time ad-network inventory and can differ from prior issues (issue #7 ran 2 ads). Future runs: place the single highest-payout offer first, then attempt additional ones one at a time and drop to placeholders when the API says capacity is exhausted.
Offer IDs from list_ad_offers rotate on every call and may be invalidated by a failed save_post; always re-fetch immediately before the save that will succeed.

email_settings keys for save_post/edit_post are 'email_subject_line' and 'email_preview_text' (NOT 'subject_line'/'preview_text'); the wrong keys are silently ignored and the subject defaults to the post title. Fixed via edit_post this run.
